mapper.select:
SELECT d.*, s.sub_name FROM lms.tb_subject_daily_log d JOIN lms.tb_subject s ON d.sub_seq = s.sub_seq WHERE s.cur_seq = #{curSeq} AND s.status = 'A' -- 과목이 활성 상태인 경우만 조회
AND d.log_date = #{logDate}::date
ORDER BY d.period ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lms.tb_subject_daily_log (sub_seq, log_date, content, status, reg_id, period, main_file_path) VALUES (#{subSeq}, #{logDate}::date, #{content}, #{status}, #{regId}, #{period}, #{mainFilePath}) ON CONFLICT (sub_seq, log_date, period) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, status = EXCLUDED.status, -- [수정] 파일 삭제 요청(fileDeleted=true)이면 null 적용, -- 아니면 EXCLUDED.main_file_path(새파일) 사용, -- 그것도 없으면 기존값 유지 main_file_path = CASE WHEN #{fileDeleted} = true THEN NULL WHEN EXCLUDED.main_file_path IS NOT NULL THEN EXCLUDED.main_file_path ELSE lms.tb_subject_daily_log.main_file_path END, update_id = #{regId}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
